articles.title: Taylor Swift Makes Chart History with 4 Songs in the Top 10!
articles.summary: Taylor Swift just became the first artist ever to have four songs in the top 10 on the Adult Contemporary chart at the same time—and it's not even Christmas! Her hit 'Elizabeth Taylor' helped her break a 65-year-old record.

articles.title: Who's About to Crash the Pop Charts? Meet Three Rising Stars!
articles.summary: While Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' stays at No. 1, three new artists are sneaking up the Hot 100. Stella Lefty, Yung Miami, and Malcolm Todd all hit new peaks this week—could one of them be the next big thing?

articles.title: Movie Lovers' Favorite App Letterboxd Might Get a New Owner!
articles.summary: Letterboxd, the app where 26 million movie fans rate and review films, is looking for a buyer. Big companies like Sony, Netflix, and even a Reddit co-founder are interested—but fans worry it might change the site's unique charm.
